book.name: APOCALIPSIS
book.title: QꞌU KAM IBꞌAXABꞌSA IKꞌUCHAXU TIOXH TU U XHAN (Apocalipsis) U uꞌuj uvaꞌ Apocalipsis uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan taꞌn u Xhun

content: Ni teesa u Jesús ivujpu u sello tiꞌ u uꞌuj uvaꞌ bꞌalqꞌumal
As tul kat teesa veꞌt u Kaneeroꞌeꞌ ivujpu u sello tiꞌ u uꞌujeꞌ, as kamal pokꞌoꞌchil oora uvaꞌ yeꞌxhebꞌil nik itiin veꞌteꞌ tu almikaꞌ.
As vil veꞌt vujvaꞌl unqꞌa ángel uvaꞌ txaklik veꞌt vatz u Tiixheꞌ. Kat aqꞌax veꞌt jununil trompeta ste.

As ul veꞌt umaꞌt u ángel uvaꞌ eqꞌomal umaꞌl u olibꞌ incienso staꞌn uvaꞌ qꞌan chꞌichꞌ chittuꞌ. As txakebꞌ veꞌt u ángel vatz u nachbꞌal Tiixheꞌ uveꞌ atik vatz u nimla xonlebꞌaleꞌ. As nimal chit u inciensoeꞌ kat aqꞌax ste, tiꞌ itzꞌeꞌsal viꞌ u nachbꞌal Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ qꞌan chꞌichꞌ chittuꞌ. As eela ijeꞌ u inciensoeꞌ uvaꞌ eqꞌomal taꞌn u ángel tukꞌ unqꞌa yoleꞌ uveꞌ ni tal unqꞌa itenam u Tiixheꞌ tul ninach Tiixh.
As eela ijeꞌ veꞌt visibꞌil u incienso tukꞌ u nachbꞌal Tiixheꞌ uveꞌ nibꞌan unqꞌa tenameꞌ. As techal toon vatz u Tiixheꞌ.

As kat teqꞌo veꞌt u ángel u olibꞌ inciensoeꞌ. As kat inoosa veꞌt taꞌn u txaꞌ xamaleꞌ uveꞌ atik viꞌ u nachbꞌal Tiixheꞌ. As kat taqꞌ veꞌt kuꞌ u ángel u txaꞌ xamaleꞌ vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ. As xoꞌvebꞌal chit itzetkabꞌan veꞌt unqꞌa qꞌankooeꞌ tukꞌ ivulun veꞌt umaꞌl uvaꞌ ech tabꞌileꞌ echeꞌ tuul viꞌ. As xoꞌvebꞌal chit ilitzꞌkabꞌan unqꞌa kayampaꞌleꞌ. As kat ul veꞌt kabꞌlaano.
Ni toqꞌsa vaajil unqꞌa ángel trompeta
As ibꞌan veꞌt vujvaꞌl unqꞌa ángel tucheꞌ tiꞌ toqꞌsat unqꞌa trompeta.

As toqꞌsa veꞌt u bꞌaxa ángel u trompeta. As ul veꞌt sajbꞌatz vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ, tukꞌ xamal uvaꞌ yuel tibꞌ tukꞌ kaj. As tzꞌeꞌ veꞌt chꞌoola pokꞌoꞌchil u vatz txꞌavaꞌeꞌ, tukꞌ chꞌoola pokꞌoꞌchil unqꞌa txꞌakabꞌeꞌneꞌ, as tukꞌ unqꞌa chikoeꞌ skajayil.
As toqꞌsa veꞌt vikaꞌv u ángel u trompeta. As bꞌuuqꞌ veꞌt umaꞌl u mam xamal uvaꞌ ech ichꞌiieꞌ echeꞌ umaj vitz. As kuꞌ veꞌt u xamaleꞌ tu u mar. As chꞌoola pokꞌoꞌchil u mar kat bꞌen veꞌt skajil.
As kam veꞌt chꞌoola pokꞌoꞌchil unqꞌa txooeꞌ uvaꞌ atik tu u mar. As eꞌpisal veꞌt chꞌoola pokꞌoꞌchil unqꞌa barco uvaꞌ atik veꞌt viꞌ u mar.

As toqꞌsa veꞌt u toxvu ángel u trompeta. As chajpik veꞌt kuꞌ tzan umaꞌl u nimla txꞌumil tu almikaꞌ uvaꞌ xoꞌvebꞌal chit toypeꞌ echeꞌ umaj xamal. As ech toon viꞌ u chꞌoola pokꞌoꞌchil unqꞌa nimla aꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ nixaaneꞌ tukꞌ tu u veeꞌ ni telkat chꞌuꞌl unqꞌa aꞌeꞌ.
As Ajenjo ibꞌii u txꞌumileꞌ, tan kꞌaybꞌu veꞌt chꞌoola pokꞌoꞌchil unqꞌa aꞌeꞌ staꞌn. As nimal chit unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ kat kam veꞌt taꞌn vikꞌayal u aꞌeꞌ.

As toqꞌsa veꞌt ikajvu u ángel u trompeta. As yansal veꞌt chꞌoola pokꞌoꞌchil u qꞌiieꞌ, tukꞌ chꞌoola pokꞌoꞌchil u ichꞌeꞌ, tukꞌ chꞌoola pokꞌoꞌchil unqꞌa txꞌumileꞌ. As tokin veꞌteꞌ. As yeꞌ naꞌl veꞌt u sajeꞌ tu u chꞌoola chaqꞌaal qꞌiiul. As echat ibꞌan veꞌt tu u aqꞌbꞌaleꞌ unpajte.

As tul uvaꞌ nik unsaji, as kat vil ipal umaꞌl u xichꞌ uvaꞌ nik ipal vatz almikaꞌ. As saqꞌchibꞌal chit toqꞌ txoo. As ech tal veꞌt txoo ileꞌ: —¡Txumlebꞌal chit ivatz! ¡Txumlebꞌal chit ivatz! ¡Txumlebꞌal chit ivatz unqꞌa tenameꞌ uveꞌ at kan vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ tuk ibꞌaneꞌ, tul la oqꞌsal veꞌt oxvaꞌt unqꞌa trompeta! Tan bꞌiit kuxh toqꞌsal veꞌt unqꞌa trompeta taꞌn oxvaꞌt unqꞌa ángel.
